test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Why did your manager refuse to give you the pay raise?

options.text: Why has the pay raise been refused to be given to you by your manager?
Why was the pay raise refused to be given to you by your manager?
Why had your manager refused to give you the pay raise?
Why have you been refused the pay raise by your manager?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Why did your manager refuse to give you the pay raise?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the pay raise" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "did refuse" to "was refused" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "your manager."
 
• Ensure the question format remains correct for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Why was the pay raise refused to be given to you by your manager?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Why has the pay raise been refused to be given to you by your manager?" – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"Why had your manager refused to give you the pay raise?" – This is the active voice version of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: **"Why have you been refused the pay raise by your manager?" – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
